If you are someone who like a good ambiance and a view of the city from sitting high above with your meal, you will not be disappointed. Just make sure you have a reservation for a table next to the floor to ceiling glass window.

The server assigned to our table was young and inexperienced. She was standing there to take orders no different than a high school teenager working at a fast food joint.
